evals.name: omega3-brain-health
evals.prompt: Vad sager forskningen om omega-3 och hjarnhalsa? Finns det bra studier som visar effekt, och vem har finansierat dem?
evals.expected_output: A research briefing with scientific papers about omega-3 and brain health, including funding sources and any conflict of interest flags (e.g. supplement industry funding)

evals.name: screentime-children
evals.prompt: Jag vill veta vad forskningen sager om effekten av skarmtid pa barn under 5 ar. Ge mig de mest palitliga studierna.
evals.expected_output: A research briefing with peer-reviewed studies on screen time effects on children under 5, ranked by reliability with funding transparency

evals.name: sleep-learning-preschool
evals.prompt: Finns det studier som visar att somn paverkar barns inlarning i forskolealdern? Jag vill ha riktigt palitliga kallor.
evals.expected_output: A research briefing with studies on sleep and learning in preschool-age children, with funding sources, COI statements, and emphasis on meta-analyses/systematic reviews
